history.p: Gade's "Aquarelles" were probably meant for the home rather than for the concert hall. They became extremely popular all over Europe and were published in many complete editions, in excerpts, and arrangements. The dedicatee, Frederikke Brun (1824-52), had been Gade's piano pupil before he went to Leipzig. They met again in 1851, but she died the following year of tuberculosis.

On the remaining staves: "Om Morgenen svang Fuglene sig høit Luften idet de sang: 2. I Aftenskumringen hvidskede de gamle Træer og Bækken til hinanden: 3. I Middagssolen flagrede Sommerfuglene i Kredse omkring Rosenbedet:".
